(a) the LogAnswer system can answer questions about the content of texts in a wide variety of domains; (b) the performance of automated reasoning in the context of natural language processing is crucially dependent on efficiency and robustness; (c) the combination of deductive reasoning and machine learning techniques is a promising approach to improve robustness of automated reasoning.

the LogAnswer system, based on the automated reasoning approach, can be made robust enough to answer a significant fraction of questions from the standard TREC question answering benchmark, and that the combination of deductive and inductive processing can lead to a significant performance improvement.

the combination of automated theorem proving with natural language processing is a promising approach to question answering, and that incremental reasoning and relaxation techniques are essential to make the prover efficient and robust enough for this application.
